courses.courseSubtitle: Learn the basics of programming with one of the most in-demand languages.
courses.section1Text: A comprehensive course to start your programming career. You'll learn Python fundamentals, from basic syntax to object-oriented programming, with practical examples and real projects.
topics: Variables, data types, and control structures
courses.catalogueDescription:
This course is designed to introduce beginners to the world of programming using Python.
It starts from the very basics, making it accessible even to those with no prior experience.
Students will learn how to write clean and efficient code through practical examples.
The course covers essential concepts such as variables, control structures, and functions.
It also introduces working with files, databases, and error handling techniques.
An introduction to object-oriented programming helps build a solid foundation for advanced topics.
By the end, learners will be able to create simple projects and continue their programming journey with confidence.
courses.description: Learn the basics of programming with Python, one of the most in-demand languages in the job market.

courses.courseSubtitle: Design efficient databases and master the SQL language.
courses.section1Text: Discover how to design robust and scalable relational databases. You will learn to model data, optimize queries, and manage transactions with major DBMS.
courses.catalogueDescription:
This course focuses on designing efficient and scalable relational databases.
It guides learners through the principles of data modeling and normalization.
Students will gain strong SQL skills, from basic queries to advanced optimizations.
The course also covers transactions, indexing, and performance tuning techniques.
Practical examples with MySQL and PostgreSQL help bridge theory and real-world usage.
Attention is given to best practices for maintaining reliable and secure databases.
By the end, participants will be able to design, query, and manage databases with confidence.
courses.description: Discover how to design efficient relational databases and master SQL.

courses.courseSubtitle: Automate deployment and manage containers using modern DevOps practices.
courses.section1Text: Learn DevOps methodologies and containerization with Docker. Discover how to automate the application lifecycle from build to deployment using industry‑leading tools.
courses.catalogueDescription:
This course provides an in-depth introduction to modern DevOps practices and tools.
It focuses on automating the software development lifecycle from build to deployment.
Students will learn how to use Docker to create, manage, and deploy containers efficiently.
The course also explores CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins and GitLab.
Advanced topics include container orchestration with Kubernetes.
Monitoring and logging techniques are covered to ensure system reliability and performance.
By the end, learners will be able to manage scalable and automated deployment environments.
courses.description: Automate deployment and manage containers with Docker and modern DevOps practices.

courses.courseSubtitle: Master the principles of information security and threat mitigation.
courses.section1Text: Learn to identify threats, protect networks, and implement security protocols. Covers cryptography, authentication, and incident response.
courses.catalogueDescription: This course provides a solid foundation in the fundamental principles of cybersecurity. You will learn to identify and mitigate common threats, protect corporate networks, and implement effective security protocols. The course covers topics such as cryptography, authentication, vulnerability management, and incident response. You will gain practical skills through hands-on labs and real attack simulations. By the end of the course you will be able to assess security risks and propose appropriate solutions to protect systems and sensitive data.

courses.courseSubtitle: From data processing to building advanced neural networks.
courses.section1Text: An intensive course that will guide you through the fundamental concepts of machine learning and artificial intelligence. You will explore algorithms, neural networks, and deep learning.
topics: Python libraries: scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
courses.catalogueDescription: An intensive bootcamp that will guide you through the fundamental concepts of machine learning and artificial intelligence. You will explore supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms, neural networks, and deep learning. You will use Python libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch to develop predictive models. The course includes practical projects on real-world problems like image classification, sentiment analysis, and recommendation systems. You will also learn techniques for data preprocessing, feature engineering, and hyperparameter tuning to achieve optimal model performance.

courses.courseSubtitle: Build modern, scalable web applications from scratch.
courses.section1Text: Become a complete full stack developer with this comprehensive course covering both frontend and backend. You will learn HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript.
topics: Backend: Node.js, Express, and RESTful APIs.
courses.catalogueDescription: Become a complete full stack developer with this comprehensive course covering both frontend and backend. You will learn HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript, along with popular frameworks like React for the frontend. On the server side, you will explore Node.js, Express, and both SQL and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB. The course also covers advanced topics like RESTful APIs, JWT authentication, state management with Redux, and deployment on cloud platforms. You will build complete scalable web applications, acquiring the skills demanded by modern tech companies to build successful digital products.

courses.courseSubtitle: Deploy resilient and scalable applications in the cloud.
courses.section1Text: Discover the world of cloud computing and learn to leverage market-leading platforms like AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
courses.catalogueDescription: Discover the world of cloud computing and learn to leverage market-leading cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. The course covers the fundamental concepts of cloud architecture, including IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS. You will learn to configure virtual machines, manage cloud storage, implement serverless services, and orchestrate containers with Kubernetes. You will also explore migration strategies, cost optimization, and best practices for cloud security. Through practical labs, you will gain hands-on experience deploying scalable and resilient applications in cloud infrastructure, preparing you for the most sought-after professional certifications.
